changes.comment: Derive the automatic-provisioning `team.create` request id from the inbound Feishu message that triggered it, instead of minting a fresh UUID per attempt. A message the platform redelivers now replays the same request id, so Core's idempotency answers with the Team the first attempt created rather than provisioning a duplicate for one conversation; when the first attempt died between creating the Team and installing the route, the replay reports the existing Team and the run finishes the binding, recovering instead of duplicating. Request identity is scoped to the message rather than the topic on purpose: a new message after a Team is dissolved mints a new id, so the same topic provisions a fresh Team normally. A different message arriving after a partial failure still creates a second Team, a window left undefended by design, and a redelivered id whose space policy changed in between fails loud as an idempotency conflict, reporting the message unsubmitted so it falls back to the Dispatcher Agent.
